items.trust: NARCO Asbestos Personal Injury Settlement Trust

facts.fact: Enforcement of the Section 5.3 Deemed Withdrawn Policy resumed for Intake or Review Deficient claims.
facts.timing: Required documents and information must be submitted within six months of the Trust's most recent deficiency notification on Trust Online, or June 1, 2026, whichever is later.
facts.consequence: The claim will be Deemed Withdrawn if the required action is not timely taken.

facts.fact: The same policy applies to claims on a Definite Statute of Limitations hold.
facts.timing: Required material to remove the hold must be submitted within six months of the related Trust Online hold notice, or June 1, 2026, whichever is later.
facts.consequence: The claim will be Deemed Withdrawn if the required action is not timely taken.

facts.fact: A Deemed Withdrawn claim may be refiled without affecting statute-of-limitations status; subsequent FIFO placement is based on the refiling date.

limitations: The notice's claim-specific deficiency and hold-notification fields are not populated; do not calculate individual deadlines.
Do not infer a current claim status, payment percentage, asset value, payout, or queue position.

items.trust: Pittsburgh Corning Corporation Asbestos PI Trust
items.documentTitle: Resolution — Amendment of TDP Section 5.5 (Secondary Exposure Claims)

facts.fact: Secondary-exposure claims generally require Individual Review under TDP Section 5.3(b); Disease Level VIII Mesothelioma may seek either Expedited Review or Individual Review.
The resolution states disease, direct-exposure-equivalent, same-time-frame, and causation requirements.

facts.locator: p. 1 final sentence; p. 2 specified-duration paragraph
facts.fact: For non-Level-VIII claims, the resolution states a five-times exposure-duration requirement and specific thresholds for Disease Levels II–V and VII.
All other liquidation, payment, and requirement/limitation provisions in the TDP remain applicable.

limitations: The resolution is a historical procedure source, not a rate or payment notice.
Do not use it to assess an individual claim or current processing status.

recoveredDocuments.title: WRG Resolution re: Amendment of TDP Section 5.5 — Secondary Exposure Claims
WRG Resolution with Exhibit A — ADR Procedures (Fully Executed 11-2025)
WRG Comparison ADR Procedures (September 26, 2019 to October 30, 2025)

facts.fact: Effective November 14, 2025, the amended TDP generally routes secondary-exposure claims to Individual Review; a Disease Level VIII Mesothelioma claimant may seek either Expedited Review or Individual Review.
facts.scope: The resolution also states disease, direct-exposure-equivalency, timing, causation, and additional duration/intensity requirements for non-Level-VIII secondary-exposure claims.

facts.locator: ADR resolution, p. 1; Amended ADR Procedures, p. 2
facts.fact: For an ADR request where statute of limitations is at issue, the Trust has 30 days to provide its supporting material; the claimant then has 30 days from receipt to respond; an ADR packet follows upon the earlier of response or expiration of that period.
facts.scope: The resolution adopts the ADR amendment and attaches procedures marked amended October 30, 2025.
